people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Don’t you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!
translations.bsb: Do you not know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and unite them with a prostitute? Never!
translations.kjv: Know ye not that your bodies are the members of Christ? shall I ➔ then take the members of Christ, and make them the members of an harlot? God forbid.
translations.asv: Know ye not that your bodies are members of Christ? shall I then take away the members of Christ, and make them members of a harlot? God forbid.
